Rajput Assistant ProfessorB.Com, MBA (Finance), Ph.D. (ISBR Research Centre, University of Mysore) Linkedin Link Dr. Kanchan G. Rajput is a dedicated academician with 13 years of experience in teaching. Passionate about experiential learning and innovation in pedagogy, she focuses on fostering industry-ready graduates through concept-driven instruction in finance. Her contributions span across research publications, national and international conferences and chapter publications with IGI Global. She brings a thoughtful, research-oriented approach to classroom learning, preparing students for real-world challenges in the financial sector.
